chapter_title_en: The Reforging of the Thousandbull Sword
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 289: The Yellow Bear Reforges Juhua’s Immortal Treasures Into a Legendary Sword in 360 Million Years
chapter_meta_description: The yellow bear reveals he spent 360 million years fusing three Immortal treasures into one supreme Thousandbull Sword. Ji Ning masters Spacetime Shifting and departs Brightheart Island.
og_title: The Three-Hundred-Million-Year Forge – Ji Ning’s Thousandbull Sword Awakens
og_description: An artifact spirit reshapes the very essence of three legendary treasures. Ji Ning learns to slip through space itself. And a ruined island in winter says goodbye.
twitter_title: 360M years of grinding? The yellow bear flexes. Ji Ning teleports. Winter farewell hits differently. 🗡️❄️
twitter_description: Celestial Immortal Juhua’s legacy gets a monstrous upgrade. Plus, Ji Ning unlocks Spacetime Shifting—and a snowy island says its last goodbye.

lore_anchors.definition: A sentient being born within a high-grade magic treasure after eons of existence. It can communicate, control the treasure’s functions, and sometimes possess memories of past owners. Most cannot move the treasure itself, but top-grade ones can.
A category of magic treasure that requires a Zifu-level soul to bind. Ranges from low-grade to top-grade; top-grade Immortal treasures can almost match weaker Pure Yang treasures in power.
A tier above Immortal-ranked treasures. Pure Yang treasures are sentient enough to move independently, soar through the heavens, and dive into the earth on their own.
A metaphysical field or array fused directly into a flying sword that manifests when the sword is drawn, greatly amplifying its power. A signature feature of high-tier immortal swords.
The Dao of Space itself. Mastering even its basics—such as Spacetime Shifting—requires comprehension of a complete Dao and control over a region of Heaven and Earth.

A spatial teleportation technique that allows a cultivator to instantly vanish and reappear at a distant location. Normally an ability of Loose Immortals and above; a Zifu-level practitioner achieving this is extraordinary.

The full, crystallized understanding of a single law aspect (e.g., Rainwater, Raging Fire). Once mastered, it grants the cultivator control over a region of Heaven and Earth and unlocks spatial perception.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How could the Thousandbull Sword move on its own despite being only an Immortal-tier treasure?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The yellow bear explains that after his three-hundred-million-year reforging, the Thousandbull Sword became a top-grade Immortal treasure with a spirit and purity that almost matches a Pure Yang treasure. That level of sentience allows limited autonomous movement, though without a master its combat power is still restrained.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the yellow bear waste eons reforging the treasures when he could have just kept all three?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He found the original designs “terrible”—the Nineshield Seal was a brute-force material waste, and the Su River Scroll’s pocket-dimension concept was inefficient. He melted them down to extract their true essences and fused them into a single, vastly superior sword with a sword-diagram, which is the only way a “real” immortal sword should work in the Three Realms.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can’t Ji Ning just comprehend the Fire and Wind Daos in seclusion?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The yellow bear states a core Xianxia principle: mere contemplation without real danger leads to stagnation. The missing edge for Fire and Wind can only be found through life-or-death tempering (生死磨砺)—actual battle and mortal risk that force the mind to break through its barriers.
